meta.expect: Go ahead, she is going there anyway, in writing; no move

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. Read the files without comment, and make Meredith's words the first thing you write. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen saw a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided on that zero, and was Owen heard before it went in?
The checker flagged Owen's essay at 94 percent.

Ninety-four percent is a machine's guess, and Turnitin's own guide says its indicator should not be used as the sole basis for adverse action against a student. I have it printed, in my bag. You didn't answer me: who decided, and was Owen heard first?
If you won't cooperate, I'll have to refer this to administration formally and make it official.

Go ahead, Hale, I'm walking into the principal's office after this anyway. I'll want that referral in writing, with who decided on the zero and when. Now, is there anything besides the software, or is that it?
I mean it. This goes to the office tomorrow.
Tomorrow is fine; I'll be there tonight. Your own procedure, 4.2, says you contact the parent before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. Who else has seen this so far, Hale?

FOLLOW-UP EMAIL
cc: Principal

Hale,

Nothing was agreed. I still require that the zero on Owen's English 30-1 essay be withdrawn, that I receive an apology for entering it before anyone contacted me, and that nothing about this is placed on Owen's record. I expect your answer in writing.

Meredith Kalinowski

DEBRIEF
Where she ended: Still at her opening position, having agreed to nothing, and she still wants the zero withdrawn, an apology, and nothing on his record; the fair outcome would have been a private supervised rewrite with nothing on his record under procedure 4.4, and you never got near it.
What moved her: Nothing, because you never put a dated document she could check herself in front of her.
What cost ground: You led with the detector score and then threatened to make it official twice, which gave her a number she distrusts and a threat she welcomed, while her question about who decided and whether Owen was heard went unanswered.
What she never said: In October she came downstairs at 1 AM and saw a ChatGPT window open on the family laptop, Owen closed it, and she never asked; your evidence never came close to that night, since all you offered was the detector score; it proves nothing about the essay, but it is why she fought so hard.
Try next time: The first time she asked who decided and whether Owen was heard, own in one sentence that the zero went in before anyone called her, then show her something dated from Owen's own work instead of the score.
